paired.order: alternate the frozen first pair and its reversal

within_session: paired ON minus OFF differences, including raw pair order and position
first and second pair position separately within each profile condition
previous profile condition separately within each current profile condition
cold and warmup separately from the paired samples

version_comparison.equal_weight_summary: arithmetic mean of the two session medians per version and condition; retain both original session medians
version_comparison.matched_block_order: baseline then candidate, matched by frozen first-pair order
version_comparison.condition_contrast: candidate session median minus baseline session median, separately ON and OFF
version_comparison.interaction: candidate(ON median minus OFF median) minus baseline(ON median minus OFF median), per matched block
version_comparison.paired_difference_comparison: report each session median of paired ON minus OFF separately; do not replace condition medians with it

timing_hierarchy.verification: immediate post-request QA validation, kept separately and in session totals
timing_hierarchy.request_with_checks: recorded request plus immediate-validation interval; report its actual boundary without adding nested components
timing_hierarchy.Peer: recorded transport interval ending before final receipt publication
timing_hierarchy.content_encode: inclusive existing mcp.content_encode, including relation projection and content preparation
timing_hierarchy.outside_host: trace duration minus inclusive host.capture duration, on each recorded request
timing_hierarchy.outside_trace: entry duration minus trace duration, on each recorded request
timing_hierarchy.QA_probes: before includes installation and state checks; after includes restoration checks; reported separately with overlapping boundaries
timing_hierarchy.profile_scope: starts when rpc_scope state is constructed, includes before sampling, overlaps both probes and execution; no subtraction as callback-only cost
timing_hierarchy.old_probe_comparison: new probe boundaries differ from the prior run; no direct old/new same-name probe subtraction or mutually-exclusive decomposition
timing_hierarchy.mode_cost_scope: ON dict counters and OFF null counters have natural recording/publication differences; ON minus OFF measures this whole mode chain, without isolating pure callback overhead

gates_before_interpretation: all attempted sessions and raw failures retained
received RPC sequence and profiler schedule binding
initial profile state clean, actual state matches requested, restoration verified
unchanged current facts and capture generation within a session
same cold/warmup/pair business history in each session
zero product writes and images, protected asset and owned process cleanup
cost_accounting: keep whole preparation, startup, verification, session, close and saved-record publication costs in recorded scope; keep extra metadata/control RPCs in totals
possible_conclusions: difference persists in this controlled sequence
difference varies with profiler or request order
